Overclaiming alts (that asserted something not visible) had their live altText corrected immediately per directive §7A; see phase10Proposal.interimAltCorrectionApplied and previousAltText. No asset is human-approved.

humanReviewSchema.note: Per-asset humanEditorialReview is the Phase 10.6 sign-off record. status: required|approved|rejected|replaced. Five lanes (food, safety, cultural, accessibility, brand) each: decision (approve|reject|replace|defer|""), reviewer, date, notes. Populated ONLY by an operator via review/index.html -> npm run review:apply. Agents never approve. qa.humanEditorialReview remains the legacy required-flag.
